book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Mahundo kuhuma kwa aghohi
Akaafalisayo na amoo bha Ahunda bha malaghilo bhaahumite ku Yelusalemu bhakikwemukila kuulongolo ghwa Yesu.
Bhakiabhona amoo bha ahundwa bha Yesu bhakilyegha hilyo kwa mabhoko ghabhe kya nga kukuha handa mughapalite malaghilo gha Akaayahudi.
Akaafalisayo na Akaayahudi bhoha kahone kulyegha hilyo mbaka akuhe mabhoko ghabhe mbaka ku kingogho kiyaha angukamulila hitohe hya aghohi bhabhe.
Paahuma ku hindandabhanji kahone kulyegha mbaka akuhe. Kangi yibhegha hitohe hingi hiyoloho hya ahalite handa bhula kughulula ndebho, hibhigha na hilibhi hya mahabha.
Hino bhala ahunda bha malaghilo na Akaafalisayu bhakinkonya Yesu, “Yibha bhuli ahundwa bhako bhangutughila ng'obhe mihumu ya aghohi bhetu mbole yake angulyegha kwa mabhoko ghana kinyakali?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Mbuye Isaya kakilondola hoto ya kya mwenga, mwenga maafyangu, handa pakatyekite,

content.text: Chapanga kangulongela, ‘Bhandu abha bhangunyikitila kwa milomo yabhe,
peni miyoyo yabhe yibhegha kutali na nenga.
paakihunda hitohe hya anabhandu paakighomba agho ndo malaghilo gha Chapanga.’
Mwenga muyileka malaghilo gha Chapanga na kuyikamula mihumu ya anabhandu.”

content: Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mwenga mmegha na njenjelo ya kuyilema ngwilikiho ya Chapanga ngati muyikamule mihumu yenu!
Kwa nhwano, Musa kakighomba, ‘Ghubhayikitile tate na ma ghwako’ na ‘ywoheli ywakanligha tate ghwake ebu ma ghwake kakomwe’
Peni mwenga mungughomba, mundu ywakanng'ombiliti tate ghwake ebu ma ghwake kukita, ‘Kila kya kukutanga ghwenga ndo Kolibani’ kukita kibhibhegha lilumbo lya kya Chapanga,
Mbole ya agha kangukwilika ng'obhe kuntanga tate ebu ma ghwake.
Kwa njenjelo ayi mwenga munguyuyuha lilagho lya Chapanga kwa mihumu yenu yimulibhikilite. Mwenga mukutenda mihalu miyoloho yakya njenjelo ayo.”
Mihalo yinakun'bhika kakatende ulemwa kwa kya Chapanga
Yesu kakilukema kangi lula lumati lwa bhandu na kakiaghombela, “Nnyihwanile, bhoha na mmanye nlando aghu.
Kahone kilibhi kina kunyingiha mundu kakatende ulemwa kwa kya Chapanga, peni kina kummuka ndo kina kunbhika mundu kakatende ulemwa kwa kya Chapanga.
Handa mundu ywoheli yuna makutu gha kuyihwa, na kayihwe.”
Pakalulekiti lula lumati lwa bhandu na kuyingila munyumba kati, ahundwa bhake bhakinkonya mana ya ndambulo yila.
Kakiayanga, “Na mwenga mmanya ng'obhe? Mmanya ng'obhe kukita kilibhi kinakunnnyingila kahone kunbhika mundu kakatende ulemwa kwa kya Chapanga?

Kiyaha mundu pakalyegha kilibhi kingunnyingila ng'obhe mu mwoyo maha mulutumbo, mbole kingummuka panji ya mmili bhake.” Kya kulongela naha Yesu kakihiteghekeha hilyo hyoha kukita hya maha kwa kulyeghwa.
Kakighendelela kughomba, “Kila kinakummuka mundu ndo kingunbhika kabhe na ulemwa kwa Chapanga.
Kiyaha kuhuma mumwoyo ghwa mundu kungubhuka, hwachilo ya mahakataho na utyahe na bhwihi na kukoma na
lumatamata na tama ya uhakata na ukiluko na uhwangi na tama ya utopelo na malili na maligho na lukilu na ubhughabhugha.
Mihalu ayi hyoha yinguhuma mu mwoyo ghwa mundu naywo na ndo yina kunbhika mundu kabhe nhokela.”
Kuhyubhalila kwa nndala Nsilofoinike

Ndo Yesu kakibhuka akwo na kakighenda ku nnima ghubheghite ugheghela na Tilo. Kakiyingila mu kitutubhi kimo, na mwene kakipala ng'obhe bhandu amanye kukita kabhegha amo. Peni kakihotola ng'obhe kulihiha.
Peni nndala yumo ywakabheghite na nhinja nndokwa naywo kakibhegha na mandilu kakiyihwa mihalu ya Yesu na kakinhikila na kakichutamila mayughwa muulongolo ghwa Yesu.
Hinu aywo nndala kakibhegha ng'obhe Nnyahudi, nkolannima ghwa ku Foinike ya akwo Silia. Kakinnyupa Yesu kakaghabhuhe mandilu kwa nhinja ghwake.
Yesu kaking'ombela, “Ghubhaleke bhana ayukute huti, yibhegha maha ng'obhe kutola hilyo ya bhana na kuataghila kabhwa.”
Peni yula nndala kakinnyanga, “Bambo, na akabhwa abheghite pahi pakindangabhala alyeghagha mahighalo gha hilyo hya bhana.”
Ndo Yesu kakinnyanga, “Kiyaha ya kya liyango alyo, ghughende kulubhagha lwako na yula lindilu kammuka kala nhinja ghwako.”
Kakibhuya kulubhagha lwake na kakinmona nhinja ghwake kakighonja paulili, na lila lindilu likimmuka kala.
Yesu kangunlamiha mundu ywanga kuyihwa na yuna kimama
Mbole Yesu kakibhuka ako ugheghela na Tilo, kakipitila Sidoni mbaka Dekapoli nnima ghuna hitami mbinda mabhoko yimo mbaka kakihika kulihibha Galilaya.
Akwo bhandu bhakinnyeghela mundu yumu ywa nga kuyihwa na kana kimama, bhakinnyupa kakannyabhikile kibhoko kyake ngati kakannlamihe.
Mbole Yesu kakinnyegha yula ywa nga kuyihwa kutali na bhandu, Yesu kakinnyingiha hikonji hyake mu makutu ghake, kakihuna mata muhikonji hyaki na kakilubyala lulimi lwa yula mundu.
Mbole kakilolekeha kunani kuluhingo kakitweta kwa makakala kakinng'ombela, “Efata!” Mana yake “Hughuka.”
Kamu, makutu ghake ghakihughuka na lulimi lwake lukilekekehwa kakiyanda kulongela maha.
Yesu kakibhakwilikiha bhakotoo kunnongela mundu ywohele mihalo aywo. Peni paabhakanikihite ndo bhakiyonjokeha kulandamiha munu mihalu aywo.
Bhandu bhoha bhakikangacha munu, bhakilongela “Katenda mihalo hyoha yinakunoghela munu, kabhatangatila bha nga kuyihwa, kuyihwa, na bhana kimama bhalongele.”
